overview.heroTitle: Truth does not choose for a human.
overview.heroLead: Getting Strange is a 2D narrative game set in the aesthetic of 1970s/80s Polish modernism and retro-futurism. You play as Lena Wolska — an engineer of vacuum correlation apparatus at the Institute of Spatial Continuity (IKP), who discovers overlapping branches of reality in the city of Rówień following an anomaly on Tram Line 4.
overview.heroDesc: The game eliminates traditional combat in favor of physical Anchor (Material Stabilization) and Yield (Compliance), where players stabilize geometry and make irreversible identity choices free of moralistic good/evil binaries.
overview.sandboxControls: A/D: Move | SPACE: Jump | C/Shift: Anchor | R: Restart | 1-5: Switch Chamber
overview.pillar1Desc: Shifting and freezing objects in space (Anchor) stabilizes level geometry against the destructive spatial correction wave of UCP.
overview.pillar2Desc: The climax enforces no single moral: choose Return to the lonely lab at 21:45, Reconciliation with Marta Kurek, or Testimony of two truths across the city.
overview.pillar3Desc: 100% of sound effects — from oscilloscope tones to Line 4 radio and porcelain resonance — are generated mathematically in real-time without sample files.
